 Compression plates 
 Compression plates
Compression tests are mainly carried out using compression plates. These are selected according to the following criteria: 
Rigid or flexible (parallelism of the sample) 
dimensions 
Required hardness 
Maximum force and strength 
round 20 kN compression plates for spring testing
diameter: 150 mm 
both plates are fixed 
optional with exchangeable mandrel 
tiltable round 250 kN compression plates
Diameter: 150 mm 
upper plates can be tilted by max. +/-3° 
suitable for application in temperature chamber 
squaric compression plates
different sizes available 
different engravings/drill patterns possible (foam testing according to ISO2439, ISO3386) 
round 250 kN compression plates with measuring probes and splinter protection
Up to 3 measuring probes possible (individual evaluation or averaging) 
Splinter protection
